top.line: What a sovereign website offers a job seeker, from a better CV to becoming an agentic worker.

in-short.line: A site, not a presentation; a better CV from £50; levels of involvement; agentic workers; a choice.

presentation.line: A website that shows the depth of your work, you in action and a video of you talking.

levels.line: The site, yours to change, the team inside, an agentic worker: each a choice.

agentic.line: Being hired as an agentic worker is valuable; the site gives a crash course on a plate, with evidence.

choice.line: Some want only the site, which is a product on its own; many will want to go further.

open.line: What each level includes, prices, how the course is given, how to show the work.

limits.line: A proposal; the crash course not built; no job guaranteed.

sources.line: My own thinking on 21 November 2026, and the career articles before it.
